#### Tools

```{r}
#### Translate
translate_DNA <- function(dna_data){
  clean_dna <- gsub("[^ACTG]", "", dna_data)
  DNA_strings <- Biostrings::DNAStringSet(clean_dna)
  translations <- as.character(Biostrings::translate(DNA_strings))
  return(translations)
}

#### Trim CDR3
trim_CDR3 <- function(seq_vec){
  return(substr(seq_vec, 2, nchar(seq_vec)-1))
}

top_groups <- function(results, clone_var){
  return(table(results[[clone_var]])[order(table(results[[clone_var]]), decreasing = T)])
}

unproductive <- function(results){
  return(results[which(!grepl("\\*", results$VHH, fixed = F)),])
}
```

```{r, warning=F}
S1 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S1_data_p_genotyped_clone-pass.tsv",

S2 <- read.csv("~/VHH/data/S2_data_p_genotyped_clone-pass.tsv",

# Rename clones

# Rename clones

S3$experiment <- rep("S3", each = nrow(S3))
```

## Load Query Sequences

```{r}
file_name <- "~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/Query-Seqs/XLL-H6-family-of-SmCA-binders_VHHs_9-23.fasta"

parse_fasta <- function(file_name){
  queries <- as.data.frame(cbind(names(bioseq::read_fasta(file_name, type = "AA")),
                               bioseq::read_fasta(file_name, type = "AA")))
  row.names(queries) <- NULL
  
  colnames(queries) <- c("id", "sequence")
  
  queries$id <- trimws(queries$id)
  queries$id <- gsub(' ', '-', queries$id)
  
  queries$seq_length <- nchar(queries$sequence)
  
  return(queries)
}
```

#### CDR3 Search

```{r}
# function def
CDR3_Search <- function(dat,
                        sequences,
                        insert_cost,
                        delete_cost,
                        substitute_cost){
  
  # Count junction_aa length
  # dat$junction_aa_length <- nchar(dat$junction_aa)
  
  # For each CDR3
  for (i in 1:length(seqs$sequence)){
    # Pull the name
    CDR3_ID <- seqs$sequence_id[i]
    # Pull the junction_aa
    CDR3 <- seqs$sequence[i]
    
    # calculate distance metric indexed by Query VHH name
    dat[[CDR3_ID]] <- stringdist::stringdist(seqs$sequence[i], 
                                             dat$junction_aa, 
                                             method = "lv",
                                        weight = c(insert_cost, 
                                                   delete_cost, 
                                                   substitute_cost))
  }
  return(dat)
}
  
```

```{r}
res <- CDR3_Search(df, seqs, 
                   insert_cost = 1, 
                   delete_cost = 1, 
                   substitute_cost = 1)
```

```{r}
pull_clone_id_and_junction <- function(dat, seqs, group_id){
  # 
  results <- data.frame()

  for (nm in unique(seqs$sequence_id)){
    results <- rbind(results, cbind(nm,
                                    seqs[seqs$sequence_id == nm,]$sequence,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$clone_id,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$family,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$junction_aa,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$experiment,
                                    dat[which.min(dat[[nm]]),]$VHH))
  }
  
  colnames(results) <- c("sequence_id", 
                         "sequence",
                         "family",
                         "clone_id",
                         "junction_aa", 
                         "experiment",
                         "VHH")
  
  return(results)
  
}
```

## Subset clones for each Sequence_id

1. Subset for each sequence id based on clone

2. Calculate levenshtein distance for each

3. Order by distance

4. Compute multiple sequence alignment

#### Pull clones for a given sequence

```{r}
res_list <- list()
tmp_results <- data.frame()

# Cluster by experiment
for (experiment_set in unique(res$experiment)){
  
  tmp_results <- res[res$experiment == experiment_set,]
  
  # Then by clones
  for (nm in colnames(res)[7:ncol(res)]){
      # Create an empty spot if it doesn't exist
      if (is.null(res_list[[nm]])) res_list[[nm]] <- data.frame()
      # Subset clones
      
      # tmp <- res[res$clone_id == tmp_results[tmp_results$sequence_id == nm,]$clone_id,]
      
      tmp <- res[res$clone_id == tmp_results[which.min(tmp_results[[nm]]),]$clone_id,]
      
      # Remove duplicate junction_aas (for now)
      tmp <- tmp[!duplicated(tmp$junction_aa),]
      
      # Subset relevant information
      tmp <- tmp[order(tmp[[nm]], decreasing = F), c("sequence_id",
                                                     "junction_aa",
                                                     "VHH",
                                                      nm,
                                                     "experiment",
                                                     "clone_id",
                                                     "family")]
      
      # Correct distance to the # of substitutions
      # tmp[[nm]] <- tmp[[nm]]/0.05
      
      tmp$sequence_id <- paste(nm, ':', tmp$sequence_id, sep = '')
      
      # Add new columns
      tmp$Query_VHH_id <- rep(nm, each = nrow(tmp))
      tmp$Query_VHH_CDR3 <- rep(seqs[seqs$sequence_id == nm,]$sequence)
      
      colnames(tmp) <- c("DB_sequence_id", 
                         "DB_VHH_CDR3",
                         "DB_VHH",
                         "distance",
                         "experiment",
                         "clone_id",
                         "family",
                         "Q_VHH_id",
                         "Q_VHH_CDR3")
      
      #tmp <- tmp[nchar(tmp$DB_VHH_CDR3) == nchar(tmp$Q_VHH_CDR3),]
      
      # Chop off front
      tmp$DB_sequence_alignment <- substr(tmp$DB_VHH, 7, nchar(tmp$DB_VHH))
      # Drop premature stop codons
      #tmp <- tmp[which(!grepl("\\*", tmp$DB_sequence_alignment, fixed = F)),]
      
      ## Rearrange columns
      tmp <- tmp[,c("Q_VHH_id", 
                    "Q_VHH_CDR3",
                    "DB_VHH_CDR3",
                    "distance",
                    "DB_VHH",
                    "DB_sequence_id",
                    "experiment",
                    "clone_id",
                    "family")]
      
      # Store in results
      res_list[[nm]] <- rbind(res_list[[nm]], tmp)
    }
}


```

## Sequence Alignment

```{r}
for (nm in names(res_list)){
  print(nm)
  # Create a data frame with amino acid sequences
  tmp <- res_list[[nm]]
  VHH_results <- data.frame()
  
  #for (experiment_id in unique(tmp$experiment)){
    
    #tmp <- tmp[tmp$experiment == experiment_id,]
  #  tmp <- tmp[grepl(experiment_id, tmp$clone_id),]

  # Convert the data frame to an AAStringSet object
  sequences <- AAStringSet(tmp$DB_VHH)
  # Perform multiple sequence alignment
  msa_result <- msa(sequences, method = "ClustalOmega")
  # Store aligned results
  tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- as.character(msa_result@unmasked)
  # Substitute spaces for the - characters
  tmp$Aligned_VHHs <- gsub('-', ' ', tmp$Aligned_VHHs)
  ## Convert distance to a percentage
  tmp$distance <- 100 - ((tmp$distance/nchar(tmp$DB_VHH_CDR3))*100)
  # Write
  VHH_results <- rbind(VHH_results, tmp)
  
  print("Writing...")
  print(nm)
  VHH_results <- VHH_results[order(VHH_results$distance, decreasing = T),]

  # file_name <- paste("~/Desktop/Shoemaker Lab/NK-vs-Rule-based/VHH_",nm,"_clustering_comparison27Jan24.csv", sep = '')
  # write.csv(VHH_results, file_name, row.names = F)
  cat('Written.\n')
  cat('\n')
}

```
